title: Two-sided local co-Choi contraction tensorizes a product-reference Schur bound

statement.quantifiers: Every finite H=tensor_i C^d_i,d_i>=2, and every complex rank-at-most-two matrix C whose range or adjoint range contains a nonzero fully product vector.
statement.assertion: The endpoint partial-trace form sum_S(-1/2)^|S| ||Tr_S C||_F² is nonnegative on that restricted support class, at every finite number of sites.
assumptions: Input-first co-Choi Jhat(Psi)=sum_ab E_ab tensor Psi(E_ba), with canonical tensor-factor permutation.
Ordinary Choi input-compression convention conjugates spanning vectors, preserving product rays.

inputs: An admitted product reference in a rank-two support plane and exact local reduction maps.
outputs: Positive Schur block on the span of that reference and any second vector; row class follows adjoint invariance.
interface.precision: Exact analytic finite-site inequality; no effective product-ray detection or full distillation compiler supplied.
costs: Dimension/site counts arbitrary finite in the proof, not a uniform efficient implementation claim.
Wu–Zou mechanism credited; precise prior-art/version review and external proof correctness remain unresolved.

proof_mechanism: Rotate each local reference to e0; A_i=I-P/2,A_i^-1=I+P.
Decompose R_i=I-F/2 and S_i into e0e0, paired e0ea/eae0 and e0perp tensor e0perp blocks, checking both signs.
Normalize S_i by R_i to a Hermitian contraction; its tensor product has spectrum in[-1,1], yielding R-S>=0.
Conclude Phi-M_u completely copositive and hence positive; apply it to zz*.
Use Schur complement and the correct Choi conjugation to obtain all vectors in the admitted input plane; use q(C*)=q(C) for row supports.
obstructions: Generic two-dimensional tensor-product subspaces need not contain a product vector.
Internally entangled references need not satisfy the two-sided local/global certificate; LA045 gives an exact failure.
No all-copy undistillability theorem for the boundary qutrit Werner state or existential NPT resolution follows.

potential_uses.target: Rank-constrained partial-trace inequalities with structured support
potential_uses.transfer_gate: Prove the product-ray support contract or a valid replacement for arbitrary support planes; preserve both-sided local domination, tensor permutation and Choi conventions.

review.source_reported: Source restricted analytic reconstruction and separate exact finite checks reported; no independent ingestion proof reconstruction, scientific replay, external correctness or priority clearance.
